properties.label: Abyssal Shadows
properties.description: Deal shadow damage over 4 turns. Each pulse uses an attack roll, with a higher damage multiplier on the final turn.

properties.label: Armor of Endless Winter
properties.description: Increase your armor and restore 20% of maximum health each turn for 3 turns.

properties.label: Standard Attack
properties.description: Attack one enemy. A successful attack roll also activates your equipped weapon effect, even if the enemy blocks or resists the damage.

properties.label: Stun
properties.description: Strike for increased attack damage and potentially stun the enemy for 2 turns.

properties.label: Barrier
properties.description: Increase your Physical resistance by 10 percentage points for 3 turns.

properties.label: Blood Thirst
properties.description: Deal a small amount of Physical damage based on your attack damage and restore health by the same base amount.

properties.label: Bloodlash
properties.description: Strike for increased attack damage and inflict further Physical damage over 3 turns.

properties.label: Chaos Blast
properties.description: Deal fire and lightning damage based on the mana remaining after paying the spell's cost.

properties.label: Chloroform
properties.description: For 4 turns, stun the enemy on turns when their health is at or below 25%.

properties.label: Death Strike
properties.description: Strike for double attack damage, then strike again if the enemy is below 20% health.

properties.label: Devour
properties.description: Make an attack that cannot critically hit. On a hit, restore at least 1 health, based on 75% of the damage roll before enemy defenses.

properties.label: Double Attack
properties.description: Make two standard attacks against one enemy.
Deal 1 fire, 1 frost, and 1 lightning damage to one enemy before defenses.
properties.label: Elemental staff effect
Endless Pain
properties.description: Stun the enemy and inflict Physical damage over 2 turns. Damage scales with your attack damage.

properties.label: Frost Bolt
properties.description: Make a standard attack, then deal additional frost damage based on your Intelligence.

properties.label: Lethal Poison
properties.description: Make a standard attack and poison the enemy for 6 turns. Poison damage scales with your attack damage.

properties.label: Magic Missile
properties.description: Deal Physical damage to one enemy with a number of damage rolls that increases with your level.

properties.label: Mutilation
properties.description: Strike for increased attack damage, then inflict Physical damage based on your Agility over 3 turns.

properties.label: Shadow Bolt
properties.description: Deal amplified attack damage as shadow damage, with a 50% chance to inflict Abyssal Shadows for 4 turns.

properties.label: Sneak Attack
properties.description: Make a standard attack, with a chance to attack again that increases with the enemy's remaining health.

properties.label: Strike
properties.description: Make an attack with additional damage from your damage bonus. Requires an equipped weapon.

properties.label: Stunner
properties.description: Stun one enemy for 2 turns.

properties.label: Expose Corruption
properties.description: Attack and deal fire damage, then burn the enemy and reduce their armor and block chance for 3 turns. Clues strengthen the effect; cultists take extra fire damage.

properties.label: Sanctified Ward
properties.description: Heal yourself, then improve armor, Physical resistance, and hit chance while restoring health and mana for 3 turns. Clues strengthen the ward.

properties.label: Wayfarer's Stride
properties.description: Restore mana, then improve Agility, block chance, and hit chance while restoring health and mana for 3 turns. Discovered routes strengthen the effect.

properties.label: Smuggler's Mark
properties.description: Deal Physical damage and mark one enemy for 3 turns, reducing their block and hit chances while dealing more damage. Discovered routes strengthen the mark.

properties.label: Agannazar's Scorcher
properties.description: Deal fire damage to one enemy, increasing with your Intelligence.

properties.label: Armor of Faith
properties.description: Improve your armor and your resistance to Physical and shadow damage for 4 turns.

properties.label: Bless
properties.description: Improve your hit chance for 4 turns, with a larger bonus at higher levels.

properties.label: Burning Hands
properties.description: Deal fire damage to one enemy, increasing with your level.

properties.label: Chill Touch
properties.description: Deal frost damage and reduce the enemy's hit chance for 3 turns.

properties.label: Chromatic Orb
properties.description: Deal a randomly chosen damage type to one enemy. Damage increases with your level and Intelligence.

properties.label: Cloudkill
properties.description: Inflict shadow damage on one enemy over 4 turns, increasing with your level.

properties.label: Cone of Cold
properties.description: Deal frost damage to one enemy, increasing with your level and Intelligence.

properties.label: Doom
properties.description: Reduce one enemy's armor, block chance, and hit chance for 4 turns.

properties.label: Draw Upon Holy Might
properties.description: Increase your Strength, Agility, and Stamina for 3 turns. The bonus increases with your level.

properties.label: Finger of Death
properties.description: Deal shadow damage based on your attack damage, then make an extra Physical-damage strike if the surviving enemy is below 20% health.

properties.label: Fireball
properties.description: Deal fire damage to one enemy, rolling more damage dice at higher levels.

properties.label: Flame Strike
properties.description: Deal fire damage to one enemy, increasing with your level.

properties.label: Haste
properties.description: Improve your Agility, hit chance, and critical chance for 3 turns.

properties.label: Hold Person
properties.description: May stun one enemy for 2 turns.

properties.label: Larloch's Minor Drain
properties.description: Deal shadow damage and restore your health by the same base amount. Both increase with your level.

properties.label: Lightning Bolt
properties.description: Deal lightning damage to one enemy, rolling more damage dice at higher levels.

properties.label: Melf's Acid Arrow
properties.description: Deal Physical damage immediately and over the next 3 turns. Damage increases with your level.

properties.label: Mirror Image
properties.description: Increase your block chance for 3 turns, with a larger bonus at higher levels.

properties.label: Skull Trap
properties.description: Deal shadow damage to one enemy immediately, rolling more damage dice at higher levels.

properties.label: Slow
properties.description: Reduce one enemy's Agility, hit chance, and block chance for 3 turns.

properties.label: Spiritual Hammer
properties.description: Deal Physical damage to one enemy, increasing with your level and Strength.

properties.label: Stoneskin
properties.description: Improve your armor and Physical resistance for 4 turns.

properties.label: Vampiric Touch
properties.description: Deal shadow damage and heal yourself for half its base amount. Both increase with your level.

properties.label: Web
properties.description: For 3 turns, the enemy may be unable to act each turn. Higher Agility helps them resist.

properties.label: Brace
properties.description: Once per enemy, decorate an ordinary attack below half health: gain 1 point of Physical resistance and lose 1 point of frost resistance for 1 turn.

properties.label: Arcane Bolt
properties.description: Once per enemy, convert 1 point of an ordinary attack to frost without changing its damage budget, then lose 1 point of Physical resistance for 1 turn.

properties.label: Opening Strike
properties.description: Once per enemy, decorate an ordinary attack against a guarded opponent or while wounded: reduce enemy block by 1 point for 1 turn.

properties.label: Ritual Hex
properties.description: Once per enemy, decorate an ordinary attack: reduce enemy shadow resistance by 1 point for 1 turn.

properties.label: Gather Shadow
properties.description: Warn of a coming shadow pulse while executing the ordinary selected attack.

properties.label: Shadow Pulse
properties.description: Spend 5 mana once to convert one point of an ordinary attack to shadow and reduce shadow resistance by 1 for one turn.
